title: DEPHYRIER Le Pagine (Pages Not Workers)
style: corrective synth 104 bpm trilingual EN IT FR DEPHYRIER signature pages-not-workers correction-tone CDN-pulse hi-hat sparse spoken-italian
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Queried for workers saw the zero on the screen
Called the site not deployed before the data was seen
Next on Cloudflare almost always lives on Pages
Not Workers in the cages — wrong tool wrong stages

[Pre-Chorus — Italian]
La pagina non è il worker non confondere il nome
(The page is not the worker do not confuse the name)
Il pannello giusto cambia tutto il volume
(The right panel changes the whole volume)

[Chorus — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER Pages not Workers learn the lane
Les Pages ne sont pas les Workers même domaine
(Pages are not Workers same domain)
Le pagine non sono i worker stesso brand
(The pages are not the workers same brand)

[Verse 2]
Profound failure named in plain on the post
Queried wrong surface and missed what mattered most
Pages dashboard separate from the Workers list
A correction filed not a hand on the wrist

[Bridge — French]
Deux surfaces un Cloudflare la confusion classique
(Two surfaces one Cloudflare the classic confusion)
Lire le bon panneau c'est ça la technique
(Read the right panel that's the technique)

[Outro — Trilingual]
DEPHYRIER Pages les Pages le pagine
Not Workers non i worker pas les Workers
DEPHYRIER lis le bon panneau
